items.title: Scarecrow Observing a Corn Plant
items.alt: A pale canvas-faced scarecrow in a plum knit cap, olive jacket and burgundy boots kneels beside a young corn plant with a plain wooden measuring stick.
items.description: A pale canvas-faced scarecrow in a plum knit cap, olive jacket and burgundy boots kneels beside a young corn plant with a plain wooden measuring stick. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.
